extraction.Name: Lucy La Point, Nee Giroux
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not desire to take her patent to her 160 acre allotment at the time she got it; but she was advised by the Indian Agency that she would have to accept it, so she did it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: borrowed $500.00 of A. Barker, of Denby, South Dakota, without giving a mortgage to him
extraction.Buyer: A. Barker, of Denby, South Dakota
extraction.Occupation/Income: she and her child are supported by her second husband, Oliver LaPoint, who farms for a living
extraction.NOTES: Deponent states she is mentally incompetent; has pretty fair health; has one small child, somewhat sickly all the time; second husband is Oliver LaPoint; first husband was Charlie Giroux, who willed her 160 acres; that place is clear of debt; in 1920 borrowed $500.00 from A.
